title: 中非各界共话生物多样性保护（2026中非人文交流年）
title_en: Various sectors in China and Africa discuss biodiversity conservation (2026 China-Africa People-to-People Exchange Year)
summary: 日前，中非生物多样性保护经验交流与培训班暨“鹰飞之城”全球主题巡展在肯尼亚纳罗克郡举行，是“中非人文交流年”精品活动之一。来自中国、肯尼亚、坦桑尼亚的生态主管部门、保护区机构、公益组织和高校代表围绕社区保护、科技护野、青少年生态教育展开交流
summary_en: Recently, the China-Africa Biodiversity Conservation Experience Exchange and Training Workshop, along with the "Eagle Flying City" global themed tour exhibition, was held in Narok County, Kenya, as one of the premium events of the China-Africa Year of People-to-People Exchanges. Representatives from ecological authorities, protected area agencies, public welfare organizations, and universities from China, Kenya, and Tanzania exchanged views on community conservation, technology-assisted wildlife protection, and youth ecological education.

title: “电力稳定了，生产生活都更方便”
title_en: "Stable electricity makes production and daily life more convenient"
summary: 中国企业投资建设的乌兹别克斯坦奇尔100兆瓦/200兆瓦时储能项目已全面商业运营。该项目位于塔什干州奇尔奇克市，为首都地区首批独立电网侧储能项目之一。作为大型“绿色充电宝”，它在新能源发电富余时储能、用电高峰时释放，发挥削峰填谷、调频调压作
summary_en: The 100 MW/200 MWh Chirchiq energy storage project in Uzbekistan, invested and built by a Chinese enterprise, has entered full commercial operation. Located in Chirchiq city, Tashkent Region, the project is one of the first independent grid-side energy storage projects in the capital area. As a large "green power bank," it stores energy when renewable generation is abundant and releases it during peak demand, playing a role in peak shaving, valley filling, frequency regulation, and voltage regulation.
